+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: fff380
+title: function-length-swift breaks the batch on the same pre-flight readability guard
+---
+`builtin/validators/code-hygiene/rules/function-length-swift.md` opens with the
+same pre-flight loop the three rules of `^z69hh5a` carried:
+
+```sh
+for file in "$@"; do
+  if [ ! -r "$file" ]; then
+    printf 'function-length-swift cannot read %s\n' "$file" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+done
+```
+
+It also exits 1 on swiftlint's own `Could not read contents of` line.
+
+The two defects are the ones `^z69hh5a` states:
+
+1. It breaks the WHOLE run for ONE declined path, which
+   `builtin/validators/README.md` refuses.
+2. `[ ! -r "$file" ]` cannot answer every refusing shape. Measured on
+   `^z69hh5a`: the test is true for a path that holds no file and for a file
+   with no read permission, and FALSE for a file whose bytes are not UTF-8.
+
+`^z69hh5a` holds the worked answer for swiftlint, measured with swiftlint
+0.65.0 over one healthy file beside each refusing path:
+
+| the refusing path | status | stdout | stderr |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| a path that holds no file | 0 | each finding | 0 bytes |
+| a file whose bytes are not UTF-8 | 0 | each finding | `Could not read contents of `<path>`` |
+| a file with no read permission | 0 | each finding | the same decode line |
+
+So `[ ! -e "$file" ]` states the path that holds no file, and a `sed`
+substitution states each file swiftlint could not read, both under the
+`sah-diagnostic:` marker at exit 0.
+
+The work:
+
+- Take the same shape `missing-docs-swift` and `magic-numbers-swift` now carry.
+- Rewrite the acceptance tests
+  `the_shipped_swift_function_length_tool_rule_breaks_on_a_file_it_cannot_read`
+  and `..._breaks_on_a_file_it_cannot_decode` in
+  `crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/tool_rules/tests/shipped/function_length_swift.rs`
+  as three `declines_` tests, one for each refusing shape.
+- State each measurement in the rule body.
+
+Found while implementing `^z69hh5a`. #tool-validators #objectivity
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m07aegep0rzkv22vzffv07n9
+  text: |-
+    Swept every `shipped/*.rs` file for a decline helper of the shape the finding names. NINE wrappers stood around `verify_unreadable_file_is_declined`, in five files, not the three the review named:
+
+    | file | wrapper | what it bound |
+    |---|---|---|
+    | function_length_swift.rs | `verify_swift_length_declines` | Swift, `function-length-swift`, 1 judged file, 1 row |
+    | function_length_swift.rs | `verify_swift_length_declines_alone` | the same rule, NO judged file, NO row |
+    | function_length_dart.rs | `verify_dart_length_declines` | Flutter, `function-length-dart`, 1 judged file, 1 row |
+    | function_length_python.rs | `verify_python_length_declines` | Python, `function-length-python`, 1 judged file, 1 row |
+    | magic_numbers.rs | `verify_swift_magic_numbers_declines` | Swift, `magic-numbers-swift`, 1 judged file, 1 row |
+    | magic_numbers.rs | `verify_python_magic_numbers_declines` | Python, `magic-numbers-python`, 1 judged file, 1 row |
+    | missing_docs.rs | `verify_dart_missing_docs_declines` | Flutter, `missing-docs-dart`, the staged library, 2 rows |
+    | missing_docs.rs | `verify_python_missing_docs_declines` | Python, `missing-docs-python`, 1 judged file, 1 row |
+    | missing_docs.rs | `verify_swift_missing_docs_declines` | Swift, `missing-docs-swift`, 1 judged file, 2 rows |
+
+    Each wrapper held exactly five bound values and NOTHING else: the project types, the rule, the judged files, the refusing path, and the expected rows. Two of them (`function_length_dart.rs`, `function_length_python.rs`) also took a `path` argument, and every caller passed the one path constant of its file, so that argument bound nothing.
+
+    The callers of `verify_unjudged_file_is_declined` and `verify_declined_item_reads` are test bodies, not wrappers, so they are outside this cause.
+
+    The prevailing pattern of this suite is a probe STRUCT built by a per-file `*_probe()` function and handed to one shared `verify_*` function — `ShippedRun`, `ShippedNamedPath`, `ShippedStagedPositions`, `ShippedEmptyRun` all read that way. The decline wrappers were the one family that did not follow it.

+  id: 01m07aezensdncjrmar5d35wrd
+  text: |-
+    ### implement — changed
+    - evidence: 6 files. `crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/tool_rules/tests/shipped.rs` holds the ONE helper: a new `ShippedDeclineProbe` struct with the five bound values, and `verify_unreadable_file_is_declined(&ShippedDeclineProbe, &ShippedUnreadableFile)` in place of the six-argument function. The nine near-copy wrappers are gone, and nine `*_decline_probe()` data constructors stand in their place: `swift_length_decline_probe` and `swift_length_decline_alone_probe` (function_length_swift.rs), `dart_length_decline_probe` (function_length_dart.rs), `python_length_decline_probe` (function_length_python.rs), `swift_magic_numbers_decline_probe` and `python_magic_numbers_decline_probe` (magic_numbers.rs), `dart_missing_docs_decline_probe`, `python_missing_docs_decline_probe` and `swift_missing_docs_decline_probe` (missing_docs.rs). Each of the 27 tests calls the shared helper directly.
+    - coverage: the helper holds EVERY condition each copy held. It still names the judged files and the refusing path in the argument list, still stages the refusing path with `stage_probe_unreadable`, still hands the run to `verify_declined_item_is_stated`, and that function still makes both assertions — every expected row is reported, AND exactly one diagnostic names the declined path. The probe fields own their text, because `python_procedure`, `dart_procedure` and `expected_row` build at run time. The `path` argument two wrappers took was dropped, because every caller passed the same path constant the probe now holds.
+    - GREEN: `cargo nextest run -p swissarmyhammer-validators` gives 807 passed, 0 failed. `cargo nextest run -p swissarmyhammer-validators -E 'test(declines)'` gives 41 passed. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p swissarmyhammer-validators --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean.
+    - RED, one test for each language touched: with `sah-diagnostic:` changed to `sah-undiagnostic:` in the rule body, `the_shipped_swift_function_length_tool_rule_declines_a_path_that_holds_no_file`, `the_shipped_dart_function_length_tool_rule_declines_a_path_that_holds_no_file` and `the_shipped_python_function_length_tool_rule_declines_a_path_that_holds_no_file` each FAIL. Each rule file was written back word for word after the run.
+    - RED for the other half: with the `expected` rows of `swift_length_decline_probe` emptied, `the_shipped_swift_function_length_tool_rule_declines_a_file_it_cannot_decode` FAILS with `left: ["Sources/Judged.swift:1"] right: []`. So the reported-rows half is load-bearing through the new helper as well.
